# ImagesCSS

OutSystemsMaps 2.3.1 | Reactive/Mobile | UI flow **Styles** | privado | 4 widgets internos

Block that contains the CSS variables defining images in base64 to be used on the Map's stylesheet.

## Inputs

Nenhum.

## Placeholders

Nenhum.

## Eventos

Nenhum.

## JavaScript

Sem JavaScript proprio.
## CSS


Variaveis: `--drawingtools-sprite-leaflet`, `--popup-default-image`, `--map-container-image-google`, `--map-container-image-leaflet`, `--cluster-default-image-1`, `--cluster-default-image-2`, `--cluster-default-image-3`, `--marker-leaflet-icon`, `--marker-leaflet-icon-wp`, `--terradraw-drawingtools`

```css
:root {
    --drawingtools-sprite-leaflet: url('data:image/png;base64,');
    --popup-default-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,
/* ... truncado: 809031 chars a mais no JSON do catalogo */
```

## Como criar (verbos)

```json
{"op":"create","parent":"<placeholder ou container da tela>","type":"IMobileBlockInstanceWidget","name":"ImagesCSS1","source":"IMobileBlock:ImagesCSS","as":"$b"}
```
